ResourceHeader.Description: XRT Flare Catalog tracks solar flares observed by the X-Ray Telescope (XRT) onboard the Hinode mission. It logs event times, spatial coordinates, GOES X-ray classes, and specific XRT observation details, providing high-cadence imagery and movies for solar research.

Parameter.Name: ID
Parameter.Description: The event number corresponding to the broader Hinode Flare Catalog

Parameter.Name: Peak (UT)
Parameter.Description: The time of peak GOES X-ray flux, in Universal Time (UT)

Parameter.Name: X
Parameter.Description: The coordinate positions of the flare with respect to Sun-center, measured in arcseconds.

Parameter.Name: Y
Parameter.Description: The coordinate positions of the flare with respect to Sun-center, measured in arcseconds.

Parameter.Name: Class
Parameter.Description: The GOES X-ray classification (e.g., C5, M1, X1) representing flare intensity

Parameter.Name: XRT
Parameter.Description: Total number of XRT observations, excluding calibration, visible light, and flare detection images.

Parameter.Name: Flare resp.
Parameter.Description: Images captured using XRT’s special flare response program, which automatically triggers when detecting a flare.

Parameter.Name: PFB
Parameter.Description: Indicates if high-cadence data from the pre-flare buffer was downloaded (Yes, No, or NA)

Parameter.Name: SOT
Parameter.Description: The number of concurrent observations taken by other onboard or partner instruments.

Parameter.Name: EIS
Parameter.Description: The number of concurrent observations taken by other onboard or partner instruments.

Parameter.Name: RHESSI
Parameter.Description: The number of concurrent observations taken by other onboard or partner instruments.

Parameter.Name: NOAA Region
Parameter.Description: The designated number for the solar active region where the flare occurred.
